examples.en: Will they become future Olympic champions?
examples.zh: 他们会成为未来的奥运会冠军吗？

examples.en: Experiments have proved that children can swim.
examples.zh: 实验证明儿童能学会游泳。

examples.en: Children can be instructed in swimming at an early age.
examples.zh: 儿童在很小的时候就能接受游泳训练。

examples.en: There is a special swimming pool in Los Angeles.
examples.zh: 洛杉矶有一个特制的游泳池。

examples.en: They can hold their breath under water.
examples.zh: 他们能在水下屏住呼吸。

examples.en: Babies do not appear to be reluctant to enter the water.
They are soon accustomed to swimming.
examples.zh: 他们很快就习惯了游泳。

examples.en: They can pick up weights from the floor of the pool.
examples.zh: 他们能从池底捡起重物。

examples.en: The underwater tricycle race is very popular.
examples.zh: 水下三轮车比赛非常受欢迎。

examples.en: Tricycles are lined up on the floor of the pool.
examples.zh: 三轮车在池底排成一行。

examples.en: The children take part in a tricycle race.
examples.zh: 孩子们参加三轮车比赛。

examples.en: The children compete against each other.
Most of them prefer to push or drag their tricycles.
examples.zh: 他们大多数喜欢推着或拖着三轮车。

examples.en: Some children can cover the whole length of the pool.
examples.zh: 有些孩子能游完游泳池的全程。

examples.en: The pool is sixty feet in length.
examples.zh: 这个游泳池长六十英尺。

examples.en: They may become Olympic champions one day.
examples.zh: 他们有一天可能会成为奥运会冠军。

sentences.en: Experiments have proved that children can be instructed in swimming at a very early age.
sentences.zh: 实验证明，儿童在很小的时候就可以接受游泳训练。

sentences.en: Babies of two months old do not appear to be reluctant to enter the water.
sentences.zh: 两个月大的婴儿似乎并不害怕下水。

sentences.en: A game that is very popular with these young swimmers is the underwater tricycle race.
sentences.zh: 水下三轮车比赛是这些小游泳者非常喜爱的游戏。

sentences.en: Tricycles are lined up on the floor of the pool seven feet under water.
sentences.zh: 三轮车排列在七英尺深的水下池底。

sentences.en: Whether they will ever become future Olympic champions, only time will tell.
sentences.zh: 他们将来能否成为奥运会冠军，只有时间能证明。

article.en: Experiments have proved that children can be instructed in swimming at a very early age.
article.zh: 实验证明，儿童在很小的时候就可以接受游泳训练。

article.en: At a special swimming pool in Los Angeles, children become expert at holding their breath under water even before they can walk.
article.zh: 在洛杉矶的一个特制游泳池里，孩子们甚至在学会走路之前就能熟练地在水下屏住呼吸。

article.en: Babies of two months old do not appear to be reluctant to enter the water.
article.zh: 两个月大的婴儿似乎并不害怕下水。

article.en: It is not long before they are so accustomed to swimming that they can pick up weights from the floor of the pool.
article.zh: 不久，他们就习惯了游泳，甚至能从池底捡起重物。

article.en: A game that is very popular with these young swimmers is the underwater tricycle race.
article.zh: 水下三轮车比赛是这些小游泳者非常喜爱的游戏。

article.en: Tricycles are lined up on the floor of the pool seven feet under water.
article.zh: 三轮车排列在七英尺深的水下池底。

article.en: The children compete against each other to reach the other end of the pool.
article.zh: 孩子们相互竞争，看谁先到达游泳池的另一端。

article.en: Many pedal their tricycles, but most of them prefer to push or drag them.
article.zh: 许多孩子蹬着三轮车，但大多数孩子更喜欢推着或拖着它们。

article.en: Some children can cover the whole length of the pool without coming up for breath even once.
article.zh: 有些孩子能一口气游完游泳池的全程而不换一次气。

article.en: Whether they will ever become future Olympic champions, only time will tell.
article.zh: 他们将来能否成为奥运会冠军，只有时间能证明。
